scope: Two separate headless processes using real terrain worker and on-disk archive. Four curved sections publish, manual save verifies; second process loads, performs normal reload and saves. After joining worker, compare 24 exact native collision mesh packet hashes plus asphalt/air density probes.
shutdown: Snapshot writes disabled only after manual save verification; expected save-blocked teardown message prevents shutdown from manufacturing tested archive.
limits: Proves persisted terrain result. Parametric curve controls, editor preview and resumable multi-section authoring are not yet integrated or persisted. Does not repeat driving or establish frame/thermal performance.
